Tuesday, September 15, 2026

Summary

Faculty and staff now have access to Claude under a university-managed enterprise agreement.

Schools or departments may sponsor student licenses.

Yale’s enterprise agreement offers increased data protections in both a standard environment and a HIPAA-compliant environment that Yale has approved for use with ePHI.

Claude is an AI assistant created by Anthropic that you can use to draft and edit documents, summarize and analyze files, brainstorm ideas, write and explain code, and answer questions, all within Yale’s security and privacy protections. Through Yale’s Claude Enterprise subscription you will also get access to Claude Chat, Code, and Cowork*.
*Cowork is not available in the HIPAA/Zero Data Retention environment.

Available to: staff, faculty, and students (with department or faculty sponsorship)

Pricing: $20/month (Standard License).
$50/month (Premium License)

How to Access: Submit a license request. After a license has been obtained, access Claude through the web version, desktop app, or

Type

Cost

Consumption amount

$20/month per license

Up to the usage limit for a Standard seat.*

A larger amount (~5x standard) of included consumption, up to the usage limit for a Premium seat.*

*Anthropic does not publicly disclose usage limits for licenses. Limits are enforced via a rolling 5-hour window along with a weekly usage cap that resets at a fixed time specific to your account.

Individuals who regularly need more than their included allowance may submit a separate request to modify their consumption cap; usage beyond the allowance is then metered and charged to the COA. Learn more by visiting Understanding your Claud

Request a new enterprise license

If your school or department already pays for a Claude Team or API workspace, contact Software at Yale.

Faculty and staff: Submit a request indicating the license type and the charging COA.

Students: Students cannot submit requests directly. Student licenses are available when a school or department sponsors them for coursework and/or research. Contact the Software at Yale team for more information.

The university’s standard Claude environment provides access to Claude Chat, Code, and Cowork. We also offer a HIPAA-compliant environment with Claude Chat and Code for individuals working with ePHI or data requiring zero data retention. Additionally, Yale’s Claude license provides you with:

Easy and secure login: Use your Yale NetID and password to sign in.

Enhanced data and privacy protection: Yale administers these accounts. Unlike non-enterprise accounts, Anthropic (Claude’s developer) cannot use enterprise users’ prompts or outputs to train its models.
